description.value: Talay Thai Restaurant is a Thai restaurant on Vancouver's Granville Street offering a broad menu of Thai classics including curries, stir-fries, noodle dishes, and specialty seafood preparations. The restaurant has an established local following with 74 customer reviews and a signature menu section featuring house specialties. Online ordering with quick pickup makes it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Marpole–Oakridge corridor.
